description: Fetches K-pop company information from kpopping.com database, including company profiles (founder, CEO, website, socials, groups, artists) and company listings.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_company_profile: Get detailed profile for a specific company (requires slug); 参数: slug; 必填: slug
  - list_companies: List all companies, optionally filtered by first letter; 参数: letter; 必填: 无
  - search_companies: Search for companies by name (requires query); 参数: query; 必填: query

letter.description: Single letter (A-Z) to filter companies by. Optional for list_companies.

query.description: Search query for company name. Required for search_companies.
